title: Glazed Ham
description: Holiday centerpiece, sweet and sticky. Adapted from America's Test Kitchen.
steps: Place ham cut-side down in roasting pan.
Cover tightly with foil. Bake at 250°F until 120°F internal, about 2-2½ hours.
Brush with half the glaze. Bake 15 minutes.
Brush with remaining glaze. Bake until 140°F internal and caramelized, 20-30 minutes.
notes: Spiral ham is already cooked: you are heating and glazing. Heat to 140°F if it was packaged fully cooked in a USDA-inspected plant (check the label), 165°F if not.
